page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.2xlarge is a general-purpose server belonging to the ecs.re6p family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration delivers 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It features 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage and relies entirely on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance under stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression tests falls into the bottom 25% tier. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth tests, including a cached read-only small block speed of 392.36 GB/sec, rank in the average tier. The server achieves an average of 6.81 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and maintains a static web serving throughput of 6.64 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance without resource contention, making it a stable choice for its hardware class. Given the average database operations score of 2849.77 and the lack of local storage, this server is best suited for general-purpose workloads, distributed caching layers like Redis, and moderate web serving applications.
